children: Asian currencies consolidate against the dollar in early trade, but may be aided by appetite for risk assets. "The S&P 500 rose to a fresh record high, supported by optimism around AI-related spending," CBA's Samara Hammoud says in a research report. The overnight rise in equities has boosted risk sentiment, the international economics and currency strategist says. The U.S. dollar is 0.1% higher at 158.23 yen, but is little changed at 1,337.88 won while the Australian dollar is flat at US$0.6981, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
